name: Lynden Pindling International Airport

hours.v: the airport operates 24/7; individual services and counters have their own hours
hours.quote: LPIA operates 24/7, but specific services and counters have varying hours of operation.

handling.v: the airport's private flight page names two FBOs: Odyssey Aviation and Jet Nassau
handling.quote: Odyssey Aviation is a network of privately owned FBOs and Ground Handling Service Stations

notes: No Bahamas AIP (AD 2 MYNN) could be found online from an official Bahamian source. Read the Nassau Airport Development Company site (FAQs; Private Flight Services, modified 2 May 2025; Customs & Immigration page, modified 26 Feb 2026, gives no hours for private flights). The FAA IFIM Bahamas page (dated 1 Nov 2014) was read but not used because it is out of date. The FAQ gives terminal security hours (06:00-22:00) for passengers, not customs hours for private aircraft. Owner should obtain the Bahamas AIP from the Bahamas Civil Aviation Authority / Air Navigation Services Division.
